newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates steady in short market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates steady in short market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound edged to between 10 1/2 and 10 3/4 as a short private sector market continued, compared to 10 1/8 and 10 1/2 percent on Monday's range, bankers said.
"I think the short market will continue to the end of the week," one banker said.

One-week rates were at 10 1/2 and 10 3/4 percent from Monday's 10 1/4 and 10 3/8 percent. Public sector banks, which normally lend at 10 1/2 percent, were asking for about 11 percent, one banker said.
